title: End-to-End Weather Data Pipeline
description: Designed and implemented a fully automated end-to-end data pipeline to ingest real-time weather data from an API, store it in AWS S3, load into Snowflake, and transform it using dbt. Orchestrated workflows using Apache Airflow with scheduled runs and built interactive dashboards in Tableau for monitoring weather trends.

title: Instacart Customer Behavior Analytics
description: End-to-end analytics pipeline using AWS S3, Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, and Tableau to analyze customer ordering patterns, retention, and product demand.

title: FintechPayments Analytics Platform
description: End-to-End analytics engineering project that ingest raw payment data into Snowflake, transform it using dbt, and delivers KPI-driven executive dashboard in Tableau.

title: GLPI IT Operation Analytics
description: Built SQL-driven analytics on GLPi ITSM data focusing on SLA tracking,ticket trends,backlog aging, and KPI reporting with improved data quality and insights
